title: fisk-ai A2A v1 answer request
description: Answers a question the conversation is still waiting on, for a caller that was asked something and could not answer before the run gave up. The run is resumed and the conversation gains no turn. A deferred call takes the answer as its result; an approval is asked again by the resume and answered from here.

replay.description: Send this many blocks of the stored conversation before the first new event, for a caller that wants to see what it is answering into.
